description: Register an App before its first deploy. Reserves <name>.telbase.ai, runs the plan's checks (a refusal says what the plan allows and what credits would cost; ask the user, never buy credits yourself), creates the provider project, and returns the Telbase URL and the deploy command. A Vercel App's directory is linked in .vercel/project.json. With database postgres or sqlite, also creates its database and returns the commands that reach it. With service and path, adds a further service (such as an API at /api) to the registered App instead: one App, one URL, one sign-in.

database.description: postgres or sqlite to create the App's database.

directory.description: The directory the App is deployed from; a Vercel App's .vercel/project.json is written there. Defaults to the current directory.

framework.description: Vercel framework preset, such as nextjs or vite.

name.description: App name: 2 to 56 lowercase letters, digits and dashes. It becomes <name>.telbase.ai.

path.description: With service: where the App's URL serves it, such as /api (default /<service>). The service receives the full path.

provider.description: vercel for websites, Next.js, Vite, static and Node apps; cloudrun for Docker, Python, Go or anything that needs a container.

root_directory.description: The app's folder inside the repository, for a Vercel monorepo.

service.description: Add a further service, such as api, to the registered App name instead of registering one: its own Vercel project or Cloud Run service, served under the App's URL at path, counted with the App.

name: register_app
